articles.title: Sea Anemones Have a Secret Superpower Against Viruses!
articles.summary: Scientists found a brand-new way sea anemones fight viruses. A protein called CARDIB does the OPPOSITE of what a similar human protein does. It actually SLOWS the immune system to help protect the animal. This changes what we know about how animals evolved to fight germs.

articles.title: Hubble Snaps a 13-Billion-Year-Old Fireworks Show for July 4th!
articles.summary: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope took a picture of a sparkly star cluster called NGC 6426 to celebrate July 4th. It's 13 billion years old—almost as old as the universe! The red, white, and blue stars look like a cosmic firework. It sits in the outer edge of our Milky Way galaxy.

articles.title: A Brain Protein Called Arc Might Be Spreading Alzheimer's!
articles.summary: Scientists found that a brain protein named Arc helps toxic Tau—the sticky stuff in Alzheimer's—travel from sick brain cells to healthy ones. In mice, removing Arc stopped the spread. This could lead to new treatments that trap Tau before it moves. The study is in the journal Cell.
